name: Jellyfin AndroidX Media3 libraries - media3-ffmpeg-decoder
description: Media3's FFmpeg audio decoder as packaged by Jellyfin: the Java and JNI parts are Media3's (Apache-2.0), libffmpegJNI.so is FFmpeg built without GPL or version 3 parts (LGPL-2.1-or-later). The GPL-3.0 in its POM is the packaging repository's licence, not the shipped code's.
